selected.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
selected.model_revision_policy: Resolve main once at run start, record the immutable Hugging Face commit, and download that commit.
selected.registry_metadata_note: The pinned qwen36 FamilyCapabilities.tools bit is false even though docs/api.md and the qwen36 gateway renderer support native tool calls; every run must pass the behavioral tool-call probe.

selection_reasons: Colibri registers a 262144-token maximum for the qwen36 family.

The gateway implements Qwen3.6 native tool-call and tool-response translation; because the pinned family registry's descriptive tools bit is stale/false, the run treats only the behavioral probe as proof.
The pre-converted int4-gs64 checkpoint is materially smaller than Colibri's larger high-context families.
Only 10 of 40 layers use full attention, giving a better long-context state curve than the all-attention Qwen3-Coder alternative on Kaggle-class host memory.
The CUDA expert tier supports NVIDIA devices; the runner enforces its documented 256-slot full-residency precondition and refuses a silent CPU fallback.

promote_to_131072_only_after: The 65536-token endpoint and Agent Core probes complete.
Observed host memory headroom remains safe.
operating_policy.never_infer: The 262144-token architectural ceiling is not evidence that a particular Kaggle allocation successfully served 262144 tokens.

alternatives.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B
alternatives.decision: not selected for the first high-context run
alternatives.reason: Its 19.4 GB checkpoint and coding specialization are attractive, but all 48 layers use full attention, so long-context KV state is a worse fit for a typical Kaggle host-memory envelope.

alternatives.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash REAP 150B
alternatives.reason: The 84.7 GB checkpoint exceeds the conservative storage budget for this first reproducible Kaggle lane.

alternatives.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
alternatives.reason: The 185.6 GB checkpoint does not fit the intended Kaggle notebook storage envelope.
